clovePaper.description: Detecting clove quality in Indonesia still relies on manual labor, so errors often occur when sorting cloves. The quality of cloves depends on good weather: unpredictable weather prolongs the drying process and leaves the cloves damaged and moldy. In this study, we use a CNN architecture with several combinations, namely the number of convolutions, the number of dense layers, and the size of the layers. The CNN architecture is trained using several variations of the color space and several variations of image segmentation to classify clove quality. This study used three color spaces (RGB, HSV, and YCbCr) and two segmentation methods (Otsu segmentation and HSV color segmentation). The best result is obtained using the HSV color space, the original dataset, and the E-5C-64LS-4D architecture, reaching 96% accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-Score. To get a better model, we use the proper image segmentation method and compose a suitable color space to improve the CNN architecture's performance.
